reason: The first three premises are directly and accurately supported by the cited evidence (E1, E2, E3) from the same study, which reports the exact processing conditions, measured property improvements, and oxidation threshold increase. premises: UHPS at 15 GPa/1450 °C yields fully dense, grain-refined ZrB₂ with high dislocation density
Grain refinement and high dislocation density increase hardness ~46% and toughness ~69% vs. high-temperature sintered ZrB₂
The UHPS microstructure raises the oxidation threshold temperature by ~250 °C (to ~1100 °C)
The refined, dense microstructure will enhance resistance to liquid plating-metal corrosion
